name: Howl at the City
source:
Brioche has mastered the art of being small.

In a city that watches Beastmen with polite smiles and tightened hands, he keeps his shoulders straight, his voice measured, his temper locked behind careful breathing. At the café, he is dependable. At rehearsal, he is steady. In public, he is harmless. That is how you survive.

But at night, behind the studio walls, the drums tell a different story.

As HoundBites claws its way from obscurity toward something bigger, Toast finds himself standing at the center of a sound that refuses to stay quiet. Old friends pull him forward. Old fears drag him back. Every performance chips at the armor he built to stay safe, and every spotlight feels less like warmth and more like exposure.

The city calls Beastmen dangerous when they defend themselves. Brioche has spent years proving he is not.

Now he has to decide whether staying silent is protection… or surrender.

[From [url=https://houndbites.itch.io/howl-at-the-city]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Brioche掌握了小型化的艺术。

在这座以礼貌的微笑和紧握的双手注视着兽人的城市里，他挺直了肩膀，说话的声音很谨慎，他的脾气被控制在小心的呼吸之下。在咖啡馆里，他是可靠的。排练时，他表现得很稳定。在公共场合，他是无害的。这就是你生存的方式。

但到了晚上，在录音室的墙后，鼓声讲述着一个不同的故事。

当HoundBites从默默无闻走向更大的目标时，Toast发现自己站在一个拒绝保持安静的声音的中心。老朋友拉着他向前走。旧日的恐惧把他拖了回来。每一次表演都会在他为确保安全而打造的盔甲上产生缺口，每一次聚光灯都感觉不像温暖，而更像是暴露。

当兽人自卫时，这座城市称他们为危险人物。布里欧什多年来一直在证明他不是。

现在他必须决定保持沉默是保护……还是投降。

[来自[url=https://houndbites.itch.io/howl-at-the-city]Itch.io[/url]]
